themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents that perform research tasks, autonomously or semi-autonomously, often acting as researchers themselves or assisting researchers in complex workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code, including code generation, completion, and review.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, extracting key information and insights.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores AI tools and techniques specifically applied to the design process and user research, aiding in concept generation, prototyping, and analysis.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to assist researchers in various stages of the research process, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Articles about integrated AI platforms designed to support research activities, offering a suite of tools for data analysis, hypothesis generation, and knowledge discovery.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on studies and discussions about the behavior, impact, and use cases of AI chatbots in various contexts, including user interactions and potential risks.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines the effects of AI on jobs, employment, and the workforce, including job displacement, skill requirements, and new career opportunities.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Discusses the application of AI in automating software testing processes, improving efficiency, accuracy, and coverage in quality assurance.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, review, and assess the effectiveness and usability of different AI tools for specific applications.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
